international.title: Costa Rica bars UN rapporteur on Palestinian territories from entering the country
international.summary: Francesca Albanese, leading critic of Israeli abuses in Gaza and West Bank, barred on ‘national security grounds’ Costa Rica barred entry to the UN special rapporteur on the Israel-occupied Palestinian territories, Francesca Albanese, earning the ire of the UN human rights chief. Albanese, an Italian national, went to Costa Rica to receive an honorary doctorate from the University of Costa Rica. She was stopped at the airport in San José and not allowed to enter the country, and was transferred to a hotel before she travelled to Mexico on Saturday. Continue reading...
